title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Pineapple Passion Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Pineapple Passion Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit combines two tropical favourites for a rich and exotic fruit blend. Sweet Pineapple lays the groundwork with its vibrant, tangy juiciness, while Passionfruit adds a more complex layer of sharp, aromatic depth. Together, they create a tropical medley that’s sweet, tart, and intensely satisfying. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made to fit the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods connect magnetically and work with the device’s twist-activated dual pod system, allowing quick and seamless flavour changes. With two pods per pack, Pineapple Passion is a dynamic, fruit-forward option that pairs beautifully with cooling, mint, or citrus flavours.
